name: Project Lab
source:
A mad doctor has trapped you in his lab and wants to turn you therianthropic. Your task is to escape, whether alone or not. Depending on your choice, you will meet 10 theriomorphs. These could be friends, lovers or foes.

[Edited from [url=https://huenaindie.itch.io/project-lab-dev]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位疯狂的医生将你困在他的实验室里，并想把你变成兽人。你的任务是逃跑，无论是否孤身一人。根据你的选择，你将遇到10个兽形。这些人可能是朋友、恋人或敌人。

[编辑自[url=https://huenaindie.itch.io/project-lab-dev]Itch.io[/url]]
